title: GTA 6 Release Times and Preload Guide: When Can You Start Playing?
description: GTA 6 is less than two weeks away! Check out our comprehensive guide covering PS5 preload options, release times, and essential launch info.

content:
## The Countdown to GTA 6: The Most Anticipated Launch

As probably the most anticipated game of all time, Grand Theft Auto 6 is now less than two weeks away from its official launch. With the release date drawing closer, excitement across the gaming community has reached unprecedented levels, and players are eagerly seeking out every detail regarding its upcoming release.

## PS5 Release Times and Preload Options

According to reports from gaming media outlets like Push Square, coverage is ramping up around everything players need to know about the game's PS5 launch. This includes essential details on preload options and exact release times. 

For a title of this magnitude, preloading is a critical feature that allows players to download the game files ahead of time so they can dive right into the action the moment the game unlocks. Ensuring your console has enough storage space and checking for official preload announcements will be key to a smooth launch day experience.

## Preparing for Launch Day

To make sure you are fully prepared when GTA 6 finally drops, consider taking a few simple steps:

- **Check Your Storage**: Make sure your PS5 has ample free space for the installation files.
- **Stay Updated**: Keep an eye out for official announcements regarding exact preload start times and unlock schedules.
- **Plan Ahead**: With launch day approaching fast, organize your schedule so you can enjoy the game without interruptions.

## Editor's Take

GTA 6 is undeniably a monumental milestone for the gaming industry. While we await final confirmation on precise preloading schedules, the anticipation alone is electric. Make sure your hardware is ready and keep your eyes on official updates as we approach the biggest gaming event of the decade.
